<pre><code class="language-json">{
  "openapi": "3.1.0",
  "info": {
    "title": "Pakperk API",
    "description": "Stable v1 paper-reading API with optional OIDC-backed account profiles, synchronized To Read libraries, and moderated flat paper comments. Comment publication has an independent emergency kill switch which preserves reads and safety controls.",
    "license": {
      "name": "MIT",
      "identifier": "MIT"
    },
    "version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "paths": {
    "/health/live": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "routes::health"
        ],
        "operationId": "health_live",
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Process is live",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HealthResponseSchema"
                },
                "example": {
                  "status": "ok"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/health/ready": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "routes::health"
        ],
        "operationId": "health_ready",
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Database is ready",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/HealthResponseSchema"
                },
                "example": {
                  "status": "ready"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "Dependency unavailable",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "/v1/comments/{comment_id}": {
      "delete": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Repeat-safe author deletion. Request bodies are rejected; COMMENT_CREATION_ENABLED does not disable deletion.",
        "operationId": "delete_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "204": {
            "description": "Comment is deleted",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds until the shared mutation window resets"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or COMMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      },
      "patch": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Replaces the authenticated author's comment body using optimistic version concurrency. The comment-creation kill switch does not disable author edits.",
        "operationId": "edit_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/EditCommentBody"
              },
              "example": {
                "body": "Updated observation.",
                "expected_version": 2
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Canonical edited comment",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CommentEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST, INVALID_COMMENT_BODY, or INVALID_COMMENT_VERSION",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "409": {
            "description": "COMMENT_EDIT_CONFLICT",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "422": {
            "description": "COMMENT_REJECTED",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds until the shared mutation window resets"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or COMMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/comments/{comment_id}/reports": {
      "post": {
        "tags": [
          "comments"
        ],
        "description": "Creates or returns the authenticated user's canonical report. Report detail never appears in the response or diagnostics.",
        "operationId": "report_comment",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "comment_id",
            "in": "path",
            "description": "Comment ID",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "uuid"
            }
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ReportCommentBody"
              },
              "example": {
                "detail": "Optional bounded context",
                "reason": "harassment"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Canonical idempotent report receipt",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/CommentReportEnvelope"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST or INVALID_REPORT_DETAIL",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "404": {
            "description": "COMMENT_NOT_FOUND",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds until the shared account or origin window resets"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or COMMENT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/feed": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "routes::feed"
        ],
        "operationId": "feed",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "category",
            "in": "query",
            "description": "arXiv category",
            "required": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "cursor",
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Opaque page cursor",
            "required": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "limit",
            "in": "query",
            "description": "Page size",
            "required": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": "integer",
              "format": "int32",
              "minimum": 0
            }
          },
          {
            "name": "If-None-Match",
            "in": "header",
            "description": "Entity tag returned by an earlier response for the same feed query",
            "required": false,
            "schema": {
              "type": [
                "string",
                "null"
              ]
            }
          }
        ],
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Paper summary page",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Public chronological-feed cache policy"
              },
              "ETag": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Opaque validator for this feed query and representation"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/FeedPageSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "304": {
            "description": "Feed representation has not changed; response body is empty",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Public chronological-feed cache policy"
              },
              "ETag": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Current opaque feed validator"
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "Invalid query",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {},
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "/v1/me": {
      "get": {
        "tags": [
          "accounts"
        ],
        "description": "Registered only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=true; the route is absent when the account feature is disabled.",
        "operationId": "get_me",
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Current account profile and terms state",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              },
              "ETag": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Strong profile validator in the form quoted profile-N"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AccountProfileEnvelope"
                },
                "example": {
                  "account": {
                    "comment_profile_complete": true,
                    "community_guidelines_accepted_at": "2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z",
                    "community_guidelines_current": true,
                    "community_guidelines_version": "2026-07-31",
                    "created_at": "2026-07-31T11:00:00.000Z",
                    "current_community_guidelines_version": "2026-07-31",
                    "current_terms_version": "2026-07-31",
                    "display_name": "Ada Reader",
                    "handle": "ada_reader",
                    "id": "0198f4d7-a4ce-7b40-8ee8-4f350350810c",
                    "profile_complete": true,
                    "profile_version": 2,
                    "status": "active",
                    "terms_accepted_at": "2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z",
                    "terms_current": true,
                    "terms_version": "2026-07-31",
                    "updated_at": "2026-07-31T12:00:00.000Z"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED or TOKEN_EXPIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "AUTHENTICATION_UNAVAILABLE or ACCOUNT_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds before retry when known"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      },
      "delete": {
        "tags": [
          "accounts"
        ],
        "description": "Registered only when ACCOUNT_DELETION_ENABLED=true. Every request, including an identity-scoped replay, requires recent authentication. The verified issuer/subject is the replay key; no Idempotency-Key header is accepted. A replay resumes durable externalization and returns the original operation. ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE is unusual: the account is already locally deletion_pending, ordinary access remains blocked, and the worker/operator owns completion even though the external tombstone was not yet acknowledged durable.",
        "operationId": "delete_me",
        "responses": {
          "202": {
            "description": "Deletion accepted or identity-scoped replay; clients must immediately clear credentials and account-owned local data",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AccountDeletionEnvelope"
                },
                "example": {
                  "deletion": {
                    "operation_id": "0198f4d7-a4ce-7b40-8ee8-4f350350810c",
                    "requested_at": "2026-07-31T12:34:56.789Z",
                    "state": "requested",
                    "updated_at": "2026-07-31T12:34:56.789Z"
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "400": {
            "description": "INVALID_REQUEST when the DELETE body is non-empty or any Idempotency-Key header is supplied",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "401": {
            "description": "UNAUTHENTICATED, TOKEN_EXPIRED, or REAUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED for a new operation only; identity-scoped replays never consume quota",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds before retry"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "503": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_DELETION_UNAVAILABLE proves post-commit local disable and asynchronous ownership. SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE is ambiguous and never asserts acceptance. Clients fail closed for either response after dispatch.",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds before retry"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          }
        },
        "security": [
          {
            "oidcBearer": []
          }
        ]
      },
      "patch": {
        "tags": [
          "accounts"
        ],
        "description": "Registered only when ACCOUNTS_ENABLED=true; the route is absent when the account feature is disabled. Updates use an exact strong profile ETag for compare-and-swap.",
        "operationId": "patch_me",
        "parameters": [
          {
            "name": "If-Match",
            "in": "header",
            "description": "Required exact strong profile validator returned by GET /v1/me",
            "required": true,
            "schema": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "example": "\"profile-2\""
          }
        ],
        "requestBody": {
          "description": "Supported profile fields; explicit null clears only display_name",
          "content": {
            "application/json": {
              "schema": {
                "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ProfileUpdateBody"
              },
              "example": {
                "accept_community_guidelines_version": "2026-07-31",
                "accept_terms_version": "2026-07-31",
                "display_name": "Ada Reader",
                "handle": "ada_reader"
              }
            }
          },
          "required": true
        },
        "responses": {
          "200": {
            "description": "Updated account profile",
            "headers": {
              "Cache-Control": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Always private, no-store"
              },
              "ETag": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "New strong profile validator"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/AccountProfileEnvelope"

                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"

            "headers": {
              "WWW-Authenticate": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Bearer challenge"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "403": {
            "description": "ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED or ACCOUNT_DELETION_PENDING",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "409": {
            "description": "HANDLE_ALREADY_SET or HANDLE_UNAVAILABLE",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "412": {
            "description": "PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT",
            "headers": {
              "ETag": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Current strong profile validator"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "428": {
            "description": "PROFILE_VERSION_REQUIRED",
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "429": {
            "description": "RATE_LIMITED",
            "headers": {
              "Retry-After": {
                "schema": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Seconds before retry"
              }
            },
            "content": {
              "application/json": {
                "schema": {
                  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorEnvelopeSchema"
                }
              }
            }
